title: REQ · Export source interface supplies a round's contributions and imports no removed code
summary: ExportSource interface satisfied by FileStore, with no worker or execution imports
description: Context: FileStore.ListByRound(ctx, worldID, roundID) already lists contributions. Desired behavior: a documented ExportSource interface with that method so exporters depend on an abstraction; FileStore satisfies it. Why: allows mocking and handoff independence from removed code.
acceptance_criteria: Given FileStore, when assigned to ExportSource, then it compiles
Given a fake ExportSource, when ListByRound is called, then it returns its contributions
Given export source files, when imports are parsed, then none contain worker or execution
